name: ps2_vn
title: PS2 visual novel
description: Logo title screen, pad-driven menu, and a scene of text you advance a line at a time.
detail: A deliberate first game for this machine: no physics, no scrolling, no per-frame budget to blow -- textured quads and text. The logo and an 8x8 font sheet are compiled in as GS textures, and the alpha test does the cut-outs. Menu navigation matches the PS1 shooter's shape: a title, a menu, and scenes you move between.
